$comment: Coldline Task 3.9 public answer contract. The figures copied from the student's own two run summaries, the pair of sampled traces they compared, a structured comparison on three dimensions, and the recommendation. The topology contract checks compare the run figures and the trace ids with the generated summaries as written; the protected check compares the comparison's split_effect values and the recommendation's decision with the answer key. There is no self-attestation field, no pass boolean, and no recording URL.
title: Coldline Task 3.9 answers
description: Run figures from both profiles, the trace pair, the three-dimension comparison, and the recommendation.

answers.description: The only top-level answer mapping accepted by the public verifier.

runs.description: The five fields copied, as written, from each profile's generated summary.

trace_pair.description: One sampled trace id from each summary and what the two traces show.

note.description: What the two traces show about where the time went and what the failure reached.

comparison.description: One entry per dimension: whether the split helped it, where the evidence comes from, and a note.

recommendation.description: Which topology to tell Dana to run, or that these runs cannot settle it, with the note she reads.

note.description: In Dana's terms: what two services gain, what they cost operationally, which way you would go, and one limit of what two local runs prove.

trace_id.description: A Jaeger trace id, lowercase hexadecimal, copied from a summary's sampled trace list.

readings_p95_ms.description: The summary's readings_p95_ms: p95 latency of reading submissions, in milliseconds.

status_p95_ms.description: The summary's status_p95_ms: p95 latency of status reads, in milliseconds.

throughput_per_second.description: The summary's throughput_per_second: readings carried from accepted to terminal per second over the run.

failure_window_errors.description: The summary's failure_window_errors: failed requests and readings that ended FAILED inside the failure window.

split_effect.description: Whether running the API and the worker as two services made this dimension better, worse, or left a difference the two runs cannot support.

evidence.description: Where the observation behind the value comes from.

note.description: The figures or the trace detail behind the value, in plain words.
